Subject: Refund request

Hello, I purchased Yakeen NEET 2.0 last week but I have decided to join an offline coaching instead. Please refund my fees of Rs 4,500.

Regards,
Sneha
reasons: Needs account/payment action: Refund request for a purchased batch (Rs 4,500) needs an agent to check the account, payment and eligibility.
rows.reply: Hi Sneha, thanks for reaching out. Online batches are non-refundable once bought, and this applies whatever the reason, including deciding to join another coaching [RF-1]. The only exceptions are a batch bought by mistake, payment errors, and book orders damaged or lost in delivery [RF-1]. Since you bought the batch last week, if it was bought by mistake you can ask for a switch to another batch of the same amount within 10 days of purchase, by sharing your order ID, the batch you bought and the batch you want [RF-2]. Any refund or batch change request is reviewed by a support agent, who checks your order against the policy and replies with a decision [RF-4].
